relationships.detail: The outer cylindrical surface and central through bore share the tube's Z axis, consistent with the concentric boundaries in the end view.
The bore end radii meet the central bore surface at both axial ends.

assumptions.text: Grouped end_view:F1 with section_view:F1 as the same outer cylindrical surface based on the unique tube surface identified in both views and their consistent axial orientations; no numerical match was inferred from the truncated end-view text.
